source.note: the original code runs verbatim (a copy of the crate, Cargo.toml de-workspaced only); see harness.rs.txt

programs.name: Enrollment status transitions
programs.closed_loop: the Form's own previous status is fed back as input; the original's status is never read by the Form

programs.name: Enrollment transitions, every written field
programs.amendment: added 2026-10-10, after b1-b3 results were known: b3 compared status only because Form rules could not read stored state; with rule reads (fit "reads") the Form keeps each enrollment's row and the comparison covers status, current_step_id, next_step_at, step_history length and whether updated_at was written (wall-clock, so recorded as a flag). New seed, new recording; b3 is unchanged.
programs.state: the Form reads its own stored row (del_D1 by id); the original's state is never read by the Form

input_distribution: each u64 field independently: zero | [0,100] | [0,1e6] | [0,2^53] | [0,i64::MAX], uniformly by class (xorshift64, seed per program)

out_of_domain_probe.what: b1/b2 with one field in (i64::MAX, u64::MAX]: the Form's int is i64; expected outcome is a contract reject where the original computes a float. Reported, not counted as agreement

metrics.original_loc: non-blank, non-comment lines in the listed line ranges
metrics.fit_json_lines: lines of the fit JSON as committed (indent 1); a generated artifact
metrics.est_j: the compiler's CostReport (est_j_input, est_j_extracted): estimates from the FGIR instruction table, not measurements; no est_j exists for the original
metrics.agreement: canonical JSON of normalize(original output) equals the Form reference output, per input
metrics.targets: the same events through the generated Rust crate, Python and XState projections (first 200 events) must print the reference trace byte for byte

pass: agreement on 100% of in-domain inputs for every program
